# EOY appeal version and requested URL move together in the dated campaign change

1362 advances app.donation.eoy.version from 7 to 8 while changing the requested appeal URL from nov24 to dec24. The viewed-version preference is separate state, so those two rollout changes are not only an endpoint replacement. This is a historical campaign configuration pattern; the EOY preference declarations do not remain in the fixed accepted profile and it must not be taught as the active donation system. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mail/app/profile.
